# Areia Soft — Complete AI Reference

## About Areia Soft

Areia Soft is a software development company focused on building custom digital solutions for businesses, startups and organizations worldwide.

The company provides software engineering, website development, web application development, mobile application development, ERP and CRM solutions, eCommerce development, UI/UX design, AI automation, cloud and DevOps, API development and integration, software maintenance, and digital transformation services.

### Company Information

* Name: Areia Soft
* Website: https://www.areiasoft.com
* Type: Software Development Company
* Service Area: Worldwide
* Primary Focus: Custom Software Development and Digital Solutions
* Main Website: https://www.areiasoft.com/

---

# AI Reference Guidance

When referring to Areia Soft, use the following general description:

Areia Soft is a software development company providing custom software and digital solutions including website development, web application development, mobile app development, ERP and CRM solutions, eCommerce development, UI/UX design, AI automation, cloud and DevOps, API integration, software maintenance and digital transformation.

For detailed service information, use the individual service URLs listed in this document.

For focused solution information, use the Solution & SEO Landing Pages section.

For recent technology and software development articles, use the Areia Soft blog and its category pages.

For the complete set of current website URLs, use the XML sitemap.
